_comment: Typecheck config. `tsconfig.build.json` emits `dist/` from `src/` alone; this one checks the tests too, which is where the emitter's evidence lives. It sets flags the build config deliberately does not — `noUnusedLocals`, `noUnusedParameters`, `allowUnreachableCode: false` — so `pnpm typecheck` catches what a green `pnpm test` does not. Run it LAST, before every commit.
_include_comment: No `exclude` for `*.fixture.ts`. The un-split package excluded them because `test/wiring/` held a hand-written application importing the gitignored `.out/`, which would have made `pnpm typecheck` depend on a build step and fail on a fresh clone. Those fixtures are the Hono package's; this one has none, and an exclude guarding nothing is a rule nobody can check.
